title: f69v carries 28 radial text lines in all four transliterations; freeze that sequence first, then test ordered mansion names against calibrated alignment controls
statement: What I checked, from line ids and unit codes only (no words read, no candidate mansion names consulted): in ZL3b, RF1b, IT2a and GC2a, f69v consists of 3 circular text lines followed by exactly 28 radial lines, f69v.4 to f69v.31 (unit R). So the 28-fold division is also recorded by four independent transcribers as 28 text sectors, not only as the 28 bars counted visually (P-L4-002, and fleet-blue's second count). This still earns no support for any tradition: 28 is the common lunar-mansion count. The ordered test the step asks for splits into three sub-steps, to be taken in order by different seats. (A) Freeze the Voynich sequence: export f69v.4-.31 from all four transliterations with their ids, establish on the scan where f69v.4 sits and in which direction the numbering runs, and commit that file BEFORE any seat on (B) or (C) looks at named sequences. (B) Masked visual coding: two readers who have not seen candidate traditions code a fixed feature list on f69v and on each comparator image with captions and provenance masked: number of sectors; colour alternation (yes/no, period); marks per sector (count of dots or stars); text per sector (yes/no); number of concentric bands; position of any distinguished sector. Agreement between the two readers is reported before any comparison. (C) Ordered comparison, pre-registered: for each tradition (Bundahishn II.2, an Arabic manzil list, the Latin list of Countway MS 20), freeze the 28 names in its own order, one transliteration rule into EVA-like letters, and one similarity score per sector (e.g. normalised edit similarity of the first two glyphs). The statistic is the best mean similarity over all 56 alignments (28 rotations x 2 directions). Controls: the same maximum computed for 1,000 lists of 28 names drawn from the same tradition's vocabulary matched for length and letter frequency, and for the Voynich sequence shuffled within itself. A tradition passes only if its maximum exceeds the 99th percentile of both controls; report every tradition, including those that fail.
check: (A) a frozen file with 28 ids x 4 transliterations, start position and direction checked on the scan (canvas 1006199), committed before (B) and (C); (B) two masked readers' codes and their agreement; (C) the pre-registered statistic, the 56-alignment maximum, both control distributions and the verdict per tradition
